guide.summary: Ubud's monkey sanctuary, textile and art galleries and Tegallalang's swing park, with cooking classes, breakfast cafés, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Most places here publish daily opening with no weekly closing day, so plan around entry times and bookings instead: the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary takes its last entrance at 5 PM, and Apéritif needs 24 hours' notice for lunch.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (9:00 AM–6:00 PM, last entrance 5 PM), Threads of Life (10 AM–6 PM) and Hujan Locale all list daily opening. Kebun Bistro says it opens seven days a week except for a few holidays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary lists adult entry at IDR 130.000 and child entry at IDR 100.000. Casa Luna Cooking School takes full payment at booking and refunds only cancellations made 5 or more days ahead; Pyramids of Chi refunds event tickets cancelled a full 48 hours before.

toolkit.label: Reservations
toolkit.copy: Hujan Locale says seating is limited, so book ahead, and Spice by Blake recommends booking ahead for the same reason. Apéritif requires 24 hours' advance booking for lunch, and Mozaic's lunch, which began on 29 October 2026, is by reservation only.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary prohibits food and drinks, asks you not to bring plastic, offers lockers in the lobby, and says not to touch or feed the monkeys. Apéritif's dress code is smart to formal with no singlets or flip-flops, and Mozaic admits children aged 6 and above.

guide.dek: Start early at the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, keep your afternoons for galleries or a cooking class, and book your dinner before you arrive.
intro: Ubud's anchor sight is the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary on Jalan Monkey Forest, open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM with last entrance at 5 PM. Adult tickets are listed at IDR 130.000. Its guidelines prohibit bringing food or drinks into the forest and ask you not to bring plastic; lockers are available in the lobby. Do not touch the monkeys or try to feed them, and dress respectfully, because the sanctuary is a sacred area.

For Indonesian textiles, Threads of Life runs a store at Jalan Kajeng 24 and a gallery on Jalan Raya Lungsiakan, both open daily from 10 AM to 6 PM. Komaneka Fine Art Gallery on Jalan Monkey Forest features its current exhibition, Nectar Waggle, though its page lists two different daily hours, so check before you go. North in Tegallalang, Alas Harum Bali opens daily from 7 AM to 7 PM, with swings, sky bikes and a flying fox. Pyramids of Chi in Bentuyung runs sound healing sessions every day.

Book your main meals. Hujan Locale on Jalan Sri Wedari serves all day from 12:00 to 22:00 and says seating is limited. Mozaic on Jl Raya Sanggingan opens its dining room daily from 6:00 PM and its Tipple Room bar from 5:00 PM, and has served lunch by reservation since 29 October 2026; children aged 6 and above are allowed. At Viceroy Bali, Apéritif asks for smart to formal dress and 24 hours' notice for lunch. Casa Luna Cooking School holds a class every day, with market visits on Tuesday and Thursday.

Mornings start early on Jalan Hanoman: Monsieur Spoon and KAFE open at 7:00, Clear Cafe at 8:00, and Kebun Bistro serves brunch from Friday to Sunday, 9 AM to 3 PM. Milk & Madu on Jalan Suweta opens at 7am and Seniman Coffee on Jalan Sri Wedari at 7:30AM. In the evening, Copper Kitchen & Bar on Jalan Bisma has a rooftop and opens until 11 pm, Spice by Blake on Jalan Monkey Forest runs from 4PM to 12AM, and the Pinstripe Bar at Viceroy Bali serves speakeasy-style cocktails.
summaryCards: Reach the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary before its 5 PM last entrance, then visit Threads of Life on Jalan Kajeng, open daily from 10 AM to 6 PM.
Start with a pastry at Monsieur Spoon on Jalan Hanoman from 7:00, then take a 3.5- or 4-hour morning class at Casa Luna Cooking School.
Reserve Hujan Locale and Spice by Blake ahead, give Apéritif 24 hours' notice for lunch, and pay in full when you book Casa Luna Cooking School.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several confirmed places show only light current evidence, such as a 2026 copyright line, a dated menu file or a promotion image (Seniman Coffee, Monsieur Spoon, Milk & Madu, KAFE, Kebun Bistro, Alas Harum Bali, Apéritif, Pinstripe Bar, Hanging Gardens of Bali, Threads of Life, Sayuri Healing Food); they are marked medium confidence. Hours were not published for The Yoga Barn, Pinstripe Bar, Bebek Bengil, Murni's Warung, Hanging Gardens of Bali or Tanah Gajah's restaurant; Komaneka Fine Art Gallery publishes two conflicting sets of hours and no exhibition run dates; Murni's Warung gives a location description rather than a street address, and its Christmas booking page carries an older post date. Sites that could not be read include Museum Puri Lukisan and Room4Dessert (certificate errors), Locavore NXT (SSL failure), COMO Uma Ubud, Four Seasons Sayan, The Samaya, Capella Ubud, Cretya Ubud and Bali Buda (403), Ubud Traditional Spa (429) and Museum Rudana (connection reset). Tegallalang Rice Terraces and Saraswati Temple have no official operator page, and Bridges Bali states it is closed permanently.
